verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents ninth-gen NVENC acceleration for DaVinci Resolve and Adobe Premiere, plus NVIDIA Studio positioning for video editing, 3D rendering, and graphic design, and RTX Video Super Resolution/HDR for browsers. However, explicit AV1/HEVC codec specifics, decoder details, and ISV-certification (e.g., Studio Driver validation lists per app) are not documented in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encode-decode spec details, formal ISV/ISV-certification documentation, independent benchmark corroboration of encoder performance.
